capabilities: apply Markdown transformations via smart symbols and a format brush
paste URLs, HTML, and Office/web tables as Markdown
generate and convert internal links, alias links, and potential links
clean up punctuation, spacing, blank lines, comments, and image links across documents
convert between tags and double links, and extract annotations
extras: Continuation of Enhanced Editing under a new plugin ID; the README advises disabling the old plugin after upgrading and reassigning its hotkeys manually. Desktop only. No telemetry or network requests, and no default hotkeys are registered to avoid conflicts; some commands (headings, bold, italic, highlight, callouts, lists) are deliberately left to Obsidian core.
intentEvidence: Quick Editing is maintained by Hanser0521 from the original Enhanced Editing project, with attribution and public upstream authorization
problem: Obsidian lacks syntax-aware bulk Markdown transformations, rich-text paste conversion, and document-wide text cleanup (spacing, punctuation, blank lines) as ready-made commands.
